[2026-07-27 15:52:21] ## Changes Made ### 1. `web_ui/frontend/src/styles.css` — Two CSS class overhauls **`.message-system-as-user`** (the outer bubble for all system notifications): - **Before:** Reddish/orangish tones — `rgba(255, 100, 100, 0.1)` background, `rgba(255, 100, 100, 0.3)` border, `#c99` text color, `font-style: italic` - **After:** Very subtle accent tones — `rgba(137, 180, 250, 0.06)` background, `rgba(137, 180, 250, 0.12)` border, `var(--text-secondary)` text color (#a6adc8, muted), no italic **`.worker-output-warning-banner-warning`** (warning banner in worker output panel): - **Before:** Yellow tones — `rgba(249, 226, 175, 0.12)` background, `#f9e2af` text, `rgba(249, 226, 175, 0.3)` border - **After:** Very subtle accent tones matching the muted style — `rgba(137, 180, 250, 0.06)` background, `var(--text-secondary)` text, `rgba(137, 180, 250, 0.12)` border ### 2. `web_ui/frontend/src/components/chat/MessageBubble.jsx` — Token warning inline style removed **Inline style block** (inside `MessageContent`, the token warning special case): - **Before:** A bright yellow/amber banner with inline styles — `background: '#fff3cd'`, `border: '1px solid #ffc107'`, `color: '#856404'`, `fontWeight: 500`, custom padding/radius/font - **After:** Returns `

{msg.content}

` — same as other system notifications, matching the now-muted `.message-system-as-user` outer bubble
